title: Additive passivation strategies to improve properties of evaporation-spray coating perovskite solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00143A, Paper
Yuxin Zhang, Cong Geng, Chunyang Zheng, Huiren Zheng, Xin Zhao, Mingwei Zhu, Yong Peng, Yi-Bing Cheng
We have achieved a breakthrough in the photovoltaic conversion efficiency (19.91%) of perovskite solar cells prepared by an evaporation-spray coating process through additive engineering.
